description: Identity theft: another arrested person falsely gave the applicant's identifying information without consent, and that deception is the only reason the applicant's information is in the records. Verified application to the attorney representing the state in the prosecution of felonies in the county of residence. No hearing. Prosecutor verification, forwarding and the request for the order stay blank because they are outside-party acts. Court identity and every art. 55A.253(a) protected identifier stay blank.
syntheticDataNote: All values are obviously synthetic and are never drawn from any evidence file. Names are SAMPLE/EXAMPLE strings, the county is EXAMPLE, addresses are 000-prefixed, and every date is a round synthetic value. Dates here are participant screening answers, not sourced facts; no date in this fixture is asserted by any source.

caseData.addresseeRole: the attorney representing the state in the prosecution of felonies in EXAMPLE County

chargeData.disposition: [APPLICANT WAS NOT THE ARRESTED PERSON — DISPOSITION OF THE UNDERLYING CASE IS NOT THE APPLICANT'S]

screeningAnswers.caseNumberAndCourt: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN ANSWER — CONFIRMED AGAINST THE CLERK'S FILE BEFORE FILING]
screeningAnswers.mistakenIdentityBasis: another arrested person gave the applicant's name and identifying information

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted, and no conclusion about identity is asserted. The application states the applicant's own account; the prosecutor verifies it.
eligibilityData.waitingPeriodNote: None. There is no waiting period and no hearing: under art. 55A.256(d) the court enters a final order without one.
eligibilityData.reliefScopeNote: Under art. 55A.354 the agencies obliterate the applicant's identifying information and substitute the arrested person's. The file is not returned or destroyed and index references are not deleted.

protectedFieldsNote: Article 55A.253(a) requires the petition to carry sex, race, date of birth, driver's licence number, social security number and the address at the time of arrest, and the TRN must appear on the order under art. 55A.301. All of them are blank here and are never prefilled by any pipeline stage. How the largest counties handle sensitive data in a public civil expunction filing is a recorded release blocker; the participant supplies these by hand.
outsidePartyFieldsNote: Blank and never prefilled. The matter is a new civil action and receives a NEW cause number on filing, so no cause number can exist beforehand. The court sets the hearing not earlier than the 30th day after filing and the clerk serves under art. 55A.254; the participant does not serve. No position of the attorney representing the state, no service completion and no hearing outcome is ever stated.
attachments: Authenticated fingerprint records from a DPS FAST location (participant obtains and submits; LegalEase never receives or inspects them)
Private-entity attachment under art. 55A.253(a)(8)(C) (participant's own list)
